title: Seville by Segway
text: We did the 1 hour Segway tour in Seville and it was super fun and informative. Our guide Zac had a wealth of knowledge and so many interesting stories to share about Spain  and Seville’s history. He was kind and provided insider tips that will surely make the rest of our visit more memorable.
author: jonib235

title: Great experience
text: We loved the experience, it was our first time using a Segway and the truth is that it is much more recommended than a bike, Barry explained to us the most emblematic places in Seville and the history of its buildings and streets.
author: W4024CRcristinac

title: Segways in Seville
text: We had a wonderful time on the Segways fabulous guide what a wonderful way to see the city
author: D6628HBjohnc

title: Great experience
text: Very happy with the tour, Zack was a great guide, very knowledgeable about the city and its history and full of fun facts and interesting tangents. The Segway is a super fun way to get around the city and see the sights. Would highly recommend!
author: conormV5525BO

title: Amazing Segway tour
text: Absolutely brilliant experience - for all three of us it was our first time on a Segway and Barry gave us clear instructions and guidance. He took us to great spots around the city and was very well-informed. Amazing way to see Seville and I’d do it again!
author: Rania_11

title: Really fun and great way to see the sights.
text: This was a great way to see the sights of Seville.  The tour guide Zac gave us a safety briefing and practice and we felt very safe.  He gave us lots of historical information about the sights, took photos for us and gave us local knowledge tips.  He was very generous with the time and we had a great time.  Would thoroughly recommend them.
author: MaddieMolly

title: Family city tour
text:
Zack was an excellent guide. Three of the group were new to Segway rides and he taught them swiftly, giving them the confidence to navigate the busy city centre.
We chose the historic 1 hour tour and learned about the interesting architecture of the centre of Seville. 
We had a short riverside ride included and it was great to be able to be a bit faster on the Segway there.
We had great fun. I think I might have started a new family tradition for holidays 🤣
Highly recommended ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
author: Stephy12WestLothian

title: Segway fun in Sevilla
text:
Lucky just me and my son on the tour as out of sync school holiday. 

Zack was our guide and despite my nerves, (about not being able to do it and get travel sick!), he was very calming and knowledgeable about the City and the Segway was actually a lot of fun would highly recommend.
